edits.before: Generate GitHub Spec-Kit artifacts (all documents: README.md, spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md, progress.md, adr.md, roadmap.md) from requirements with integrated constitutional validation during generation. Use constitution-validator for standalone validation of existing artifacts. BEST FOR: feature specs, project planning, constitutional compliance. edits.after: Generates complete GitHub Spec-Kit documentation suite (README.md, spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md, progress.md, adr.md, roadmap.md) from project requirements. Optionally validates generated artifacts against constitutional guidelines during creation. For validating pre-existing artifacts, use constitution-validator instead. Ideal for feature specifications, project planning, and ensuring constitutional compliance. Tip: Track spec evolution by versioning generated artifacts with prompt-version-manager.
Title of the specification or project
High-level summary describing the feature or project scope
List of strategic objectives defining project goals, each with optional priority level (high, medium, or low)
Project requirements categorized as functional or non-functional, each with optional priority level (high, medium, or low)
Criteria that must be met for the project to be considered complete (optional)
Items explicitly excluded from the project scope (optional)
File path to the CONSTITUTION.md document for validation reference (optional)
